items.headline: San Diego State and Washington State meet in Pac-12 action
items.description: Washington State (1-7) at San Diego State (3-5), Oct. 31 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Riley runs for two scores and No. 21 Boise State pulls away from Washington State 31-10
items.description: — Dylan Riley rushed for 128 yards and two scores as No. 21 Boise State pulled away from Washington State with three touchdowns in the fourth quarter for a 31-10 victory on Saturday.

items.headline: Pac-12 matchup features No. 21 Boise State against Washington State
items.description: No. 21 Boise State (5-1) at Washington State (1-6), Oct. 24 at 6 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Atkinson leads Oregon State's high-flying offense to 48-30 win over Washington State
items.description: — Braden Atkinson threw for 347 yards and three touchdowns and Oregon State established early control to beat Washington State 48-30 on Saturday.

items.headline: Why Week 7 has all the makings of an epic rivalry week
items.description: From Alabama-Tennessee to Ohio State-Indiana, Week 7 is offering an early preview to rivalry week.

items.headline: Washington State visits Oregon State in Pac-12 matchup
items.description: Washington State (1-5) at Oregon State (4-2), Oct. 17 at 6 p.m. EDT.
